nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, m-1\}$, let $r \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $\varphi : \{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, m-1\}$. The $r$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along $\varphi$ is the family of $r$-element subsets $e \subseteq \{0, \dots, n-1\}$ such that $\varphi$ is injective on $e$ and the image $\varphi(e)$ is a block of $D$.
nodes.title: Blow-up of a hypergraph along a map

nodes.summary: Let $r, n \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $G$ be a family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, typically an $r$-uniform hypergraph. Then $G$ contains a generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_r$ (the book $B_{r,2}$) when there are edges $D_1, D_2, D_3 \in G$, not necessarily distinct, with $|D_1 \cap D_2| + 1 = r$, $D_1 \triangle D_2 \subseteq D_3$ and $D_3 \cap D_1 \cap D_2 = \emptyset$.
nodes.title: Generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_r$

nodes.summary: There exist a Steiner system $D$ of type $S(4, 5, 11)$ on $\{0, \dots, 10\}$ and an $n_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \ge n_0$, the Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n, \mathcal{T}_5)$ of the generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_5$ (the book $B_{5,2}$) equals the largest number of edges of a $5$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along a map $\{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, 10\}$.
nodes.title: Norin–Yepremyan theorem for $\mathcal{T}_5$

nodes.summary: There exist a Steiner system $D$ of type $S(4, 5, 11)$ on $\{0, \dots, 10\}$ and an $n_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \ge n_0$, the Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n, \mathcal{T}_5)$ of the generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_5$ (the book $B_{5,2}$) equals the largest number of edges of a $5$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along a map $\{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, 10\}$.
nodes.title: Turán number of $\mathcal{T}_5$ via blow-ups of $S(4, 5, 11)$

nodes.summary: There exist a Steiner system $D$ of type $S(5, 6, 12)$ on $\{0, \dots, 11\}$ and an $n_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \ge n_0$, the Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n, \mathcal{T}_6)$ of the generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_6$ (the book $B_{6,2}$) equals the largest number of edges of a $6$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along a map $\{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, 11\}$.
nodes.title: Norin–Yepremyan theorem for $\mathcal{T}_6$

nodes.summary: There exist a Steiner system $D$ of type $S(5, 6, 12)$ on $\{0, \dots, 11\}$ and an $n_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \ge n_0$, the Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n, \mathcal{T}_6)$ of the generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_6$ (the book $B_{6,2}$) equals the largest number of edges of a $6$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along a map $\{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, 11\}$.
nodes.title: Turán number of $\mathcal{T}_6$ via blow-ups of $S(5, 6, 12)$

nodes.summary: For $r, n \in \mathbb{N}$, the Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n, \mathcal{T}_r)$ is the largest number of edges of an $r$-uniform hypergraph on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ that contains no generalized triangle $\mathcal{T}_r$.
nodes.title: Turán number of the generalized triangle

nodes.summary: Let $t, r, m \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $D$ be a family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, m-1\}$. Then $D$ is a Steiner system $S(t, r, m)$ when every block of $D$ has exactly $r$ elements and every $t$-element subset of $\{0, \dots, m-1\}$ is contained in exactly one block of $D$.
nodes.title: Steiner system $S(t, r, m)$

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, m-1\}$ and let $r, n \in \mathbb{N}$. The largest blow-up size of $D$ is the maximum, over all maps $\varphi : \{0, \dots, n-1\} \to \{0, \dots, m-1\}$, of the number of edges of the $r$-uniform blow-up of $D$ along $\varphi$; it is $0$ when there is no such map.
nodes.title: Largest blow-up of a hypergraph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
